run_extract_mp3d_real: run the script to extract RGB images from Matterport3D panoramic images using multiprocessing
run_extract_rgb_images: run extract_rgb_images to convert a single panoramic image into 9 RGB JPEG images
run_batch_pano_extraction: run batch extraction of all *_pano.jpg files from a dataset directory to a save directory
refactor_extract_rgb_images: refactor extract_rgb_images to support configurable FOV, height, width, and number of images per panorama
review_aux_fn: review the _aux_fn multiprocessing helper that unpacks arguments and calls extract_rgb_images
